title: Threshold Skills: a dated design record
description:
Don't list your skills. Let them light up.

A way to keep dozens of working procedures ("skills") for an AI **without putting even a catalog of them in the prompt**. Skills live in the same memory as conversations. A skill surfaces only when the question in front of the AI is close enough to it — and even then, only its title and a query to read it.

A dated public record of the design. The implementation is not published. More: https://subtractlab.com
